name: Soft magnetic rod
full_name: Magnetic soft continuum robot with real-time DDG hard-magnetic rod simulator and inverse-design field control
group: Wang, USTC (with M. Liu and W. Huang)
target_anatomy: generic confined lumens (vascular and GI), 3D-printed lumen phantom
devices_driven: own MSCR: PDMS + NdFeB particles, rod radius 0.6 mm (1.2 mm OD), length 100 mm, magnetised tip 5 mm, E = 3.0 MPa
n_dof_detail: Helmholtz coil field (3 axes) + stepper advancer
validation_detail: 3D-printed lumen phantoms of varying geometry in Helmholtz coils; counts N.R.
key_numbers: remanent magnetisation 0.1448 A m; pulse magnetised at about 4 T; contact-force minimisation compared with passive pushing
sim_model: hard-magnetic elastic rod in discrete differential geometry with reduced-order contact (tong2025_realtime, full)
sim2real_detail: model-based: field commands computed from the simulator ran on the hardware (tong2025 Sec. 5); no learned policy
